formulas.gross_die_per_wafer: GDPW = pi*(d_eff/2)^2/S - pi*d_eff/sqrt(2*S); d_eff = wafer_diameter_mm - 2*edge_exclusion_mm; S = (sqrt(die_mm2)+scribe_lane_mm)^2  [Chiplet Actuary exploration.py form]
formulas.yield_negative_binomial: Y = (1 + A_cm2*D0/alpha)^(-alpha), alpha=10  [Chiplet Actuary, ECO-CHIP]; for DRAM use dram_die_yield_* directly (redundancy repair)
